test_title: PYST 12: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the option that is the correct direct form of the sentence.**

She said that she would not be coming to the school that day.

options.text: She had said "She must not be coming to the school today".
She said, "You will not be coming to the school today".
She said, "I may not come to the school tomorrow."
She said, "I will not be coming to the school today".

solution:
Here the correct answer is **She said, "I will not be coming to the school today".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• **'Said'** will remain unchanged.
 
• Comma and inverted commas will be added. 
 
• '**would**' will be changed into 'will'. 
 
• 'she' will be changed into 'I'.
 
• **'that day'** changes to '**today**'.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 

 
 
 

Correct Sentence:__ *She said, "I will not be coming to the school today".*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes in indirect speech:-

 Indirect Speech

 Past Continuous (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)
 
 

 Present Perfect (Subject + has/have + V3 + Object)
 Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object)
 
 

 Simple Past (Subject + V2 + Object)
 Past Perfect (Subject + had + V3 + Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)

 Simple Future (Subject + will/shall + V1 + Object)
 Present Conditional (Subject + would + V1 +Object)
